_comment: Structured by day of week, then by time slot (6am/12pm/6pm PH time) to match the 3x-daily cron schedule. Every image prompt guarantees the word DUTERTE appears visibly in the generated banner AND a realistic portrait of Rodrigo Duterte’s face is included. The script auto-selects based on the current Philippine day + time. Set IMAGE_PROMPT / FB_CAPTION env vars to override any single run.

monday.caption: Magandang umaga, mga SOLID! 🇵🇭 Simulan natin ang linggo nang may disiplina at pag-asa. Salamat, Presidente Duterte, sa pagtuturo ng tunay na disiplina para sa bayan. Tara, gising na! ☀️ #SolidDuterte #DisiplinaParaSaBayan
